ppr.methodology: Simulates a 10-team snake draft from pick 1. Every pick -- ours and the other 9 teams' -- is modeled as best-player-available by Value Over Replacement (VOR): edge score minus the edge score of the last starter-worthy player at that position league-wide (QB10/RB20/WR20/TE10 for a 10-team, 1QB/2RB/2WR/1TE/1FLEX-starter league; FLEX draws from whichever RB/WR/TE has the best remaining VOR once the fixed slots are filled). That determines our exact pick numbers: 1, 20, 21, 40, 41, 60, 61, 80, 81, 100, 101, 120, 121 for skill positions, with K and DST punted to the final two picks (140, 141) since real drafts essentially never take them earlier regardless of raw VOR.
